education.description: Add your degrees and schools. Include your focus, honors, or exchange terms.

experience.description: Add your professional roles and employer history including internships.

expertise.description: Add your hard and soft skills that help you stand out from the crowd today.

references.description: Add references from managers or coworkers, including their contact details.

declaration.description: Add your declaration by creating or uploading your personal signature.
